description: Generic engineering lifecycle. Forward transitions are narrow on purpose, and a failure returns to the state that can actually fix the problem.

states.title: Requirement
states.description: A human states what is wanted and why.

states.title: Load context
states.description: Instructions, project declaration, profile, and declared context documents are loaded.

states.title: Investigate
states.description: Establish what is actually true in the codebase before planning.

states.title: Plan
states.description: Turn findings into a bounded, ordered, verifiable plan.

states.title: Implement
states.description: Make the smallest coherent change on a working branch.

states.title: Verify
states.description: Run the declared quality gates and report their real outcomes.

states.title: Review
states.description: An independent reviewer assesses the change.

states.title: Evaluate
states.description: Assess how the agent worked, separately from whether the software passes.

states.title: Human approval
states.description: A person accepts or rejects the change. Rejection returns to planning, not to implementation.

states.title: Pull request and CI
states.description: The change is proposed for review and continuous integration runs.

states.title: Handoff
states.description: Record goal, status, decisions, blockers, failed attempts, and next steps.

states.title: Feedback
states.description: What was learned updates instructions, profiles, skills, or evals. Terminal for one task.
